title: Reactive help
summary: General agent help gives the overview; topic help reads the actual command or skill and gives the complete applicable recipe plus its exact installed deeper home. CLI root/category/command help narrows one level at a time. Outside a project, public docs and command --help remain reachable; the separate global skill/orientation delivery is still pending.
verification: Direct source/help homes inspected; observed teaching is not proof of a live answer or installed receiving context.
